# Roberta Bogany, M.Ed

> Speaker, author and workshop facilitator in Greater Houston, Texas. Certified life coach with more than 25 years in learning and development, including 14 years at Houston Methodist. Helps people navigate change and grow through life's transitions.

## Books
- Life Happens: 10 Steps to Navigating Change & Transition
- Relining the Empty Nest: A Journey of Discovery
- Amazon author page: https://www.amazon.com/stores/Roberta-Bogany/author/B08XPP79GW

## Workshops and talks
- Standing in Your Season (workshop)
- The Me Yet to Be: The Experience (guided workshop)
- Courage in Everyday Clothes
- Topics: navigating change and life transitions, personal growth and self-discovery, resilience, rediscovering purpose, confidence and reinvention.
- For organizations, community groups and faith communities.
